reuse.why: Uses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance and getRangedAmount for ranges, and getScheduledAmount now delegates to the new helper.

duplication.why: The missing/number/range dispatch was copied in four server sites and the preview; all of them now go through one getExpectedAmount.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getRangedAmount, and both client and server code consume it.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule; the Balance.tsx and api-models call-site changes are consequences of it, not unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: There is one definition, but op is optional and is threaded into getScheduledAmount as a third positional argument after a boolean, so a caller that omits it silently skips the approximate rule; there are also two overlapping entry points (getScheduledAmount and getExpectedAmount).

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getExpectedAmount (getScheduledAmount delegates to it); the client display-only callers still call getScheduledAmount without op, which here only formats the base value next to the '~' marker
